# API-412: Job timeouts in milliseconds

Type: Story
Reporter: Mei Tanaka (Platform API)
Updated: 2026-10-28

## Description

Short jobs need timeouts below one second. Add `timeout_ms` to the jobs API.
Existing integrations send and read `timeout_seconds`, and customers pin SDK
releases, so the old field must keep working through a deprecation period.

## Acceptance criteria

1. `POST /v1/jobs` accepts `timeout_ms` (1 to 3600000) or `timeout_seconds`
   (1 to 3600).
2. A request that sends both fields with values that disagree is rejected
   with HTTP 400 and error code `conflicting_timeout`.
3. Job status responses return both `timeout_ms` and `timeout_seconds`
   (rounded up to whole seconds) until `timeout_seconds` is removed, no
   earlier than release 2027.2.
4. Existing clients that send and read only `timeout_seconds` keep working
   unchanged during the deprecation period.
